en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa`d Abadi narrated to me from Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi. He said: `Abd al-`Athim b. `Abdullah al-Hasani narrated to me He said: Al-Hasan b. `Abdullah narrated to me from Yunus b. Thibyan. He said:

Abu `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as) said: Fatima (sa) has nine names with Allah: (1) Fatima, (2) Siddiqa (veracious), (3) Mubaraka (blessed), (4) Tahira (impeccable), (5) Zakiyya (pure), (6) Radiya (pleasing to Allah), (7) Mardiyya (pleased with Allah), (8) Muhaddatha (inspired), (9) Zahra (Illuminating).
Then, he said: Do you know what is the meaning of Fatima? I said: Inform me, master. He said: She is weaned (fatimat) from evil.
Then, he said: Had Amir al-Mu’minin (as) not married her, she would not have a match on the face of the Earth until the Day of Resurrection, from Adam to those after him.
